topic: Malaysia: New Economic Policy, redistribution, and development strategy
decisions: The recipe stays within the 1971-1990 NEP era and uses the 1991 New Development Policy only as a brief transition note.
The prose uses English as the primary language, with controlled Malay policy terms such as bumiputera and Dasar Ekonomi Baru.
The artifact set emphasizes both redistribution and growth so the NEP is not reduced to a single ethnic policy dimension.
The tables and figures are kept compact and deterministic so downstream validation remains straightforward.
scope_decisions: The artifact set covers one topic only and does not expand into unrelated Malaysian political history after 1990.
The structure treats the NEP as a development strategy grounded in the 1969 crisis and the state response to social fragmentation.
The policy discussion centers on poverty eradication, restructuring society, and development planning rather than on later reform agendas.
No canonical recipes, generator code, docs, or unrelated research folders were modified.
